text:
Alex Chen: heads up — GPUs in eu-west-canary started failing model pulls to S3 and our telemetry endpoints. apps get 503 from the sidecar when outbounding to 52.* IPs, ~15% of hosts impacted.
infra-bot: alert: egress-error-rate high on cluster eu-west-1 — https://kibana/redwood/alerts/egress-8241 :rotating_light:
Maria Gomez: are these the Envoy egress filters we rolled yesterday?
Sven Patel: yes, egress-filter v2 pushed last night to tighten outbound rules. guessing the allowlist missed some S3/registry IP blocks.
Liz Park: example sidecar log: `upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection failure` when trying to reach 52.95.110.1:443
Alex Chen: can someone run a quick check from an affected pod? `kubectl -n gpu-prod exec -it gpu-app-xyz -- curl -v https://52.95.110.1/health`
Maria Gomez: ran curl from app container — times out. ran same curl from host network namespace: succeeds immediately. from the sidecar proxy it's ECONNREFUSED.
Sven Patel: that matches an Envoy egress policy blocking IP-based destinations. our filter was matching on FQDN only and we accidentally removed outbound_passthrough for IPs.
Liz Park: workaround ideas: re-add outbound_passthrough OR explicitly create Cluster/Route entries for the S3 and model-registry IP ranges. This is a lightweight custom Envoy (not Istio), so ServiceEntry won't help here.
Alex Chen: can we just revert the canary to v1 while we fix the config? we need model pulls ASAP. @Sven can you rollback?
Sven Patel: rolling back now. patch I'm applying:
```bash
kubectl -n infra apply -f - <<'YAML'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: envoy-egress-filter
data:
  config.yaml: |
    # revert to v1 allowlist + outbound_passthrough enabled
    egress_filters:
      - name: allowlist-v1
    outbound_passthrough: true
YAML
```
infra-bot: deploy started for egress-filter rollback on eu-west-canary — job id 8241
Maria Gomez: after rollback verified on 3 hosts: model pull returned 200 OK, telemetry now flowing.
Liz Park: recommendation for next PR: add explicit S3 CIDR ranges (52.95.0.0/16 etc.), and add an acceptance test that curls a handful of model registry IPs during canary.
Alex Chen: opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/3217 — includes logs, rollback link, and quick mitigation steps.
Sven Patel: follow-up action: update envoy egress docs to prefer DNS-first matching, but keep IP fallback and an allowlist generator that pulls S3 ranges from public ip ranges. I'll draft the change and add tests.
Maria Gomez: marking canary incident resolved for now. will escalate to postmortem if we see >1% customer impact.
infra-bot: incident resolved (eu-west-canary). duration 12m. tags: [egress, envoy, canary]
